profile.headline: Full Stack Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a full-stack software engineer who loves solving complex problems and learning new technologies! I am looking for a team where I can collaborate with others to create new exciting projects! Feel free to reach out via LinkedIn or by email at joel.lee0401@gmail.com

Here is the list of technologies that I am already proficient in.

Front End | JavaScript (ES5 | ES6), HTML5, CSS3, React.js, jQuery, styled-components
Back End | Node.js, Express, Nodemon, RESTful API, Middleware, CRUD
Databases | MySQL, Sequelize, MongoDB, Mongoose, PostgreSQL, Cassandra
Deployment & DevTools | AWS/EC2/S3, Heroku, Webpack, Babel, Jest, Mocha, Chai
Other | Git, TDD, Postman, npm, Trello, JMeter, Loader.io, Nginx, New Relic, Agile Development

positions.title: WonderFund
positions.description:
Backend optimization of an inherited codebase of a crowdfunding web app scaled to 10+ mil data entries
Technologies: AWS/EC2,  Cassandra, Express, Node.js, Nginx, Redis, PostgreSQL, React.js

- Implemented a load balancer with multiple AWS EC2 instances to reduce the latency of requests by  80%
- Simulated over 1,000 concurrent users per second with Loader.io while maintaining a 1% error rate
- Decreased average response time of the database from 6 ms to 0.5 ms by implementing hash indexing

positions.title: COVID-Today
positions.description:
A web app that shows the current and historic values of confirmed COVID-19 cases within US
Technologies: Node.js, Express, Heroku, React, MySQL

- Created a drop-down menu that automatically adds a new date select option incorporated with new cases   
- Built a fully working CRUD web app with 3rd party API and deployed using Heroku in 2 days

positions.title: Katar-a Center
positions.description:
A user review aggregation website focused on products related to guitar
Technologies: AWS/EC2/S3,  Express, Jest, MongoDB, Mongoose, Node.js, React.js

- Utilized styled-components to build a responsive review module with search and pagination functionality
- Deployed multiple services with AWS EC2 through a proxy server using service-oriented architecture 
- Implemented unit and integration tests using Jest to achieve over 85% code coverage

positions.title: Laboratory Technician
positions.description:
- Conducted a final inspection on 10+ eye-wears to ensure the product meets the company's requirements and the customer's satisfaction
- Performed multiple tasks simultaneously with accuracy and thoroughness under time pressure and customer volume
